name: Südlohn (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Südlohn (a clover leaf and a red bend with a house on white).
history: By deed of 15 January 1971 the Regierungspräsident of Münster, Josef Schneeberger, granted the new municipality of Südlohn the right to bear arms, an official seal, a banner and a hoisted flag.

features.role: Südlohn arms — clover leaf and bend with house
